measured.host: macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon), local dev machine
measured.note: baseline_ms values are reference medians for a hosted CI runner class; they were seeded from local medians with headroom for slower shared runners. Re-baseline on the real runner with --update-baseline.

targets.description: phm --version — thin wrapper + CLI entry import cost

phm status — attention board on a fresh HOME
phm doctor — health check; spawns tool probes so it is the slowest cold path
MCP tools/list — gateway spawn + initialize + tools/list on a fresh HOME, what an MCP client feels
phantom --version — warm call through the npm wrapper shim to the native binary
